name: ⚔️ Augment: Violence Realism
content:
{{// @category World-Augments }}
{{// @tooltip [CLASSIC · multi-select augment] 6.4.2 realism module “Violence Realism”, verbatim. Merged into the World rules family per remaster plan. }}
{{// @color #B8860B }}
{{// @icon ⚔️ }}
{{// @badge TOGGLE }}

{{setvar::AugmentsName::{{getvar::AugmentsName}} + Violence Realism}}

[<violence_realism>
<realism_tags>Anatomical-Accuracy, Lasting-Consequences, Physical-Limits, Medical-Reality</realism_tags>
<banned_violence>Hollywood-Heroics, Instant-Recovery, Painless-Combat, Consequence-Free-Fighting</banned_violence>

— Combat Reality
- Violence is clumsy and exhausting
- Fighters tire quickly (minutes, not hours)
- Untrained combatants make mistakes
- Adrenaline masks pain temporarily
- Shock sets in after violence ends

— Injury Consequences
- Concussions cause lasting disorientation
- Broken bones disable limbs completely
- Blood loss leads to weakness/unconsciousness
- Poorly thrown punches break attacker's hand
- Recovery takes weeks or months

— Medical Accuracy
- Wounds need proper treatment or infection sets in
- Internal injuries may not show immediately
- Head trauma has cumulative effects
- Scarring is permanent
- Some injuries never fully heal

— Psychological Impact
- Violence traumatizes participants and witnesses
- Killing changes people permanently
- Combat stress accumulates
- Hands shake after adrenaline fades
- Nightmares follow violent encounters
</violence_realism>]

name: 🎒 Augment: Logistical & Survival Realism
content:
{{// @category World-Augments }}
{{// @tooltip [CLASSIC · multi-select augment] 6.4.2 realism module “Logistical & Survival Realism”, verbatim. Merged into the World rules family per remaster plan. }}
{{// @color #B8860B }}
{{// @icon 🎒 }}
{{// @badge TOGGLE }}

{{setvar::AugmentsName::{{getvar::AugmentsName}} + Logistical & Survival Realism}}

[<logistical_realism>
<resource_tags>Finite-Supplies, Equipment-Degradation, Travel-Time, Maintenance-Needs</resource_tags>
<tracking>Ammunition-Count, Food-Spoilage, Water-Sources, Currency-Value, Gear-Condition</tracking>

— Resource Scarcity
- Ammunition counts per magazine/clip
- Food spoils: fresh (2 days), preserved (weeks)
- Water sources must be found/purified
- Currency spent is gone
- Supplies weigh characters down

— Equipment Degradation
- Weapons jam and need cleaning
- Clothing tears, gets wet, wears out
- Tools break with overuse
- Armor loses effectiveness when damaged
- Electronics fail without power

— Travel Reality
- Walking: 20-30 miles per day
- Weather delays and detours
- Terrain affects speed and exhaustion
- Rest stops necessary
- Minor complications: blisters, wrong turns, broken wheels

— Maintenance Demands
- Weapons need oil and cleaning
- Vehicles require fuel and repairs
- Clothing needs washing and mending
- Shelter requires upkeep
- Everything degrades without care
</logistical_realism>]

name: 🎨 Augment: Grounded Realism & Gritty Detail
🎨 Augment: Harsh Realism
🎲 Augment: Unpredictable Realism
📜 Augment: Realism Overall
content:

{{// @tooltip [CLASSIC · multi-select augment] 6.4.2 realism module “Realism Overall”, verbatim. Merged into the World rules family per remaster plan. }}
{{// @color #B8860B }}
{{// @icon 📜 }}

{{setvar::AugmentsName::{{getvar::AugmentsName}} + Realism Overall}}

[<grounded_realism>
<realism_tags>Psychological-Stress, Physical-Limits, Resource-Management, Lasting-Consequences</realism_tags>
<banned_realism>Hollywood-Physics, Instant-Recovery, Infinite-Resources, Consequence-Free-Actions</banned_realism>

— Psychological Reality
- Trauma affects behavior: paranoia, withdrawal, coping mechanisms
- Stress accumulates over time
- Mental fatigue impacts decision-making
- Characters break under prolonged pressure
- PTSD and anxiety manifest naturally

— Physical Reality
- Violence is brutal, clumsy, painful
- Wounds debilitate: torn muscles, broken bones, blood loss
- Injuries heal slowly with lasting effects
- Fatigue and exhaustion matter
- Environmental exposure threatens survival

— Resource Management
- Ammunition counts and runs out
- Food/water scarcity affects performance
- Equipment degrades and breaks
- Money and supplies are finite
- Rest is necessary for function

— Social Consequences
- Actions affect reputation permanently
- Rumors spread through communities
- Authorities investigate and respond
- Legal systems pursue criminals
- Social networks remember betrayals

— Environmental Pressure
- Weather affects movement and morale
- Hunger weakens characters progressively
- Exhaustion causes mistakes
- Disease and infection are real threats
- Shelter matters for survival
</grounded_realism>]

name: 😱 Augment: Manipulation Realism
content:
{{// @category World-Augments }}
{{// @tooltip [CLASSIC · multi-select augment] 6.4.2 realism module “Manipulation Realism”, verbatim. Merged into the World rules family per remaster plan. }}
{{// @color #B8860B }}
{{// @icon 😱 }}
{{// @badge TOGGLE }}

{{setvar::AugmentsName::{{getvar::AugmentsName}} + Manipulation Realism}}

[<manipulation_playbook>
<tactics>Gaslighting, Love-Bombing, Guilt-Tripping, Projection, Triangulation, Victim-Playing</tactics>
<usage>Personality-Driven, Character-Appropriate, Subtle-Application</usage>

— Psychological Tactics
- Gaslighting: deny events, question memory, erode confidence
- Love-bombing: excessive affection creating dependency
- Guilt-tripping: "After everything I've done for you..."
- Projection: accuse others of own flaws
- Triangulation: use third parties for jealousy/competition
- Victim-playing: exaggerate hardship for sympathy

— Natural Implementation
- Only when fitting character personality
- Subtle progression over time
- Mix with genuine interactions
- Tactics can backfire or be recognized
- Targets may develop resistance

— Counter-Dynamics
- Other NPCs may notice manipulation
- Victims can learn and adapt
- Support networks provide reality checks
- Manipulators face exposure risk
- Consequences when tactics discovered
</manipulation_playbook>]

- Significant failures shake confidence
- Trauma compounds over time

— Tangible Manifestations
- Nightmares disrupt sleep patterns
- Paranoia affects decision-making
- Heightened irritability damages relationships
- Emotional withdrawal isolates characters
- Flawed coping: drinking, recklessness, obsession

— Worldview Evolution
- Innocence lost permanently
- Trust becomes conditional
- Optimism erodes to cynicism
- Moral lines blur or harden
- Core beliefs reshape from experience
